literal: farmers / if hands fold / there is not / even desired things / we have renounced / even to those who say / standing
translation: If the hands of farmers stop working, even those who claim to have renounced all desires will find they cannot endure.
modern: உழவர்களின் கைகள் வேலை செய்யாமல் மடங்கிவிட்டால், ஆசைகளை எல்லாம் விட்டுவிட்டோம் என்று கூறும் துறவிகளுக்கும் உலகில் வாழும் நிலை இருக்காது.
explanation: This couplet highlights the absolute necessity of agriculture for all human life. The phrase 'hands fold' is a vivid image for ceasing to work the land. Even ascetics who claim to have given up all worldly desires still need food to maintain their physical existence. Therefore, the spiritual and ascetic life of a society ultimately rests on the continuous labor of its farmers.
